'''Docking Bay 63''' was a privately owned [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. It was able to accommodate [[Starship/Legends|starships]] up the size of a medium freighter. It was also the docking bay located closest to the center of Ord Mynock Freeport. The docking bay had the standard assortment of equipment to refuel a ship, repair damage, and clean and refresh life support systems.<ref name="Game" />
